pages.text: The building for recruiting wizards, with two tabs: "Recruit NPC" and "Mage Resumes".

Click the "$(bold)Recruit NPC$()" button to instantly generate a wizard, with attributes rolled from the town's $(bold)current level$().$(br2)$(bold)Item  Description$()$(li)First time — $(bold)Free$() once per colony$(li)Afterwards — Each recruit costs $(bold)10000 of each of the 7 elements$()$(li)Attributes — Rolled by current level; high-attribute specialists may appear
pages.title: Recruit NPC

pages.text: About $(bold)5% of tourists are wizard tourists$(). When their three need bars are $(bold)all full$(), they leave a resume at the tavern and can be hired $(bold)for free$() — the main channel for building your wizard roster.$(br2)$(li)Up to $(bold)5 resumes$() are kept. To remove an unwanted resume, select it and click "$(bold)Reject$()" (a confirmation dialog appears).
pages.title: Mage Resumes

pages.text: $(li)Recruited wizards join with full mana and start working immediately.$(li)To increase resume sources: see the Tourist Guide on filling need bars.$(li)For wizard attributes, equipment, and combat strategy, see the Wizard NPC Guide.$(br2)Wizard NPC Guide$(br2)Tourist System Guide$(br2)Getting Started: From Empty Land to a Tourist Town$(br2)$(l:wandscape:playstyle/index_guide)Back to the Guide Index$(/l)
